page.overview:
Who is Beonin Marinye?

Beonin is a pretty Taraboner with dark honey-colored hair in a multitude of braids and blue-gray eyes so big they made her appear startled. She has a heavy accent.

She was usually quiet and watched everything carefully. Like Morvrin, she required a great deal of proof before believing anything.

Beonin has a strength in the One Power of , making her strong for an Aes Sedai. She is equal strongest among those we have information on in the Gray Ajah among the rebel faction. The Sitter Kwamesa Taramasu is her equal. The only others that are close are Merana Ambrey and Meidani Eschede at level , both of whom are conveniently sent on missions away from Salidar. She is the weakest of the Salidar Six, but not by much.

Beonin was born in the year in Tarabon. Her mother, Aeldrine Marinye, was a wealthy merchant who traded in dyes despite the disapproval of her grandmother. Her grandmother, Collaris, was a noted advocate in Tanchico and instilled a love of the intricacies of law into the young Beonin.
